text: Its gone 2am and Ive been up with my granddaughter Poppy who is 2. Shes got chickenpox, itchy spots all over and shes been scratching at them, but apart from that shes been her normal self. Temp is 38 on the ear thermometer. Something odd tonight though and Im probably overthinking it. When I asked her to show me the spots on her tummy she wouldnt put her chin down to look, she just kept her head sort of held up and pulled her vest up to her face insted. I tried getting her to look at a toy on her lap and she wouldnt drop her head for that eather, she cried when I gently tried to tip it forward. Not sure if shes just being stubborn because shes tired, I know I am.
